from.name: Supply Order Acknowledgment
from.description: The customer and Fontara acknowledge a supply order; the customer enters the quantity and the total is calculated.

body.p: Order {{order}}: replacement filter cartridges at USD 25.00 each.

Your PO number: [[text:Customer:PO number:width=160;pattern=^PO-\d{6}$;message=Use PO-123456;tooltip=Your purchase order number]]  Quantity: [[number:Customer:Quantity]]  Total (USD): [[calc:Customer:Total]]
Both parties may sign in any order. The order ships to [[prefill:Ship-to warehouse]] when both have signed.

name: Supply Order Acknowledgment
summary: A NEW document inline: the customer types a quantity and a formula tab calculates the total ([Quantity] * 25); signing order is off, so the customer and Fontara sign at the same time. The order number is locked: the sender fills it, no signer can change it. The PO number tab checks its format (PO- and six digits) with a validation pattern, a message and a tooltip. The ship-to warehouse is a sender prefill field: the sender types it before sending, on the document itself, and no recipient owns it.
emailBlurb: Please enter the quantity and sign.
